IconButton +8.190 (91.810 → 100.000) and cellsCompared 9280 → 1120 — the largest VOCABULARY CHANGE of the round, and the reason the number is not a victory lap: in Carbon an icon button IS a tooltip trigger, so its captured anatomy carried `span.cds--popover` and its whole invisible subtree (label + caret, both display:none in every combo). LIVE-DEFECT ROUND (Carbon, task #30) — RE-CAPTURED after six defects the owner found on a real canvas paste were fixed at their sources.
